reserves.name: M token held by MetaMask mUSD
reserves.issuerOrObligor: M0 permissioned issuers via the mUSD M-extension and SwapFacility

sources.label: Consensys Diligence mUSD audit, sections 3 and 4 (accessed 2026-09-30)

reserveReview.rationale: mUSD wraps M through the M0 SwapFacility: equivalent M deposits mint mUSD and mUSD burns return M. The Ethereum deployment's mToken() returned tracked M 0x866a2bf4e572cbcf37d5071a7a58503bfb36be1b at block 26086007. The reserve envelope records the immediate M claim rather than duplicating M's Treasury/cash collateral. Fresh 2026-09-30 RPC reads also identify the same M parent and 6-decimal mUSD on Ethereum, Linea and Monad; Ethereum swapFacility() returns 0xb6807116b3b1b321a390594e31ecd6e0076f6278 and canSwapViaPath(0xd925c84b55e4e44a53749ff5f2a5a13f63d128fd, mUSD, M) returns true. That existing M0 swapper is a sampled approved redemption cohort, not a claim that every holder can redeem or that it operates MetaMask distribution. The independent producer rechecks all catalog deployments, balances and the sampled route; mUSD-specific upgrade, freeze, forced-transfer and SwapFacility controls remain applicable.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Audited M-extension wrapping lifecycle and mToken() identity at Ethereum block 26086007; live balances owned by the independent m0-wrapper-underlying producer
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The immediate reserve parent is tracked M. M's internal cash/Treasury split and provider allocations remain parent-level uncertainty. Permissioned SwapFacility redemption and mUSD-specific administrative controls remain local risks; no additional USDC edge is inferred from distribution routes.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Bridge and M0 document segregated or bankruptcy-remote collateral architecture and name generic reserve partners, but do not publish mUSD-specific provider allocations, account-level terms, or rehypothecation restrictions.
